- **Screen sizes.** The interface scales up on screens bigger than 1080p
  (1440p, ultrawide, 4K) instead of shrinking to tiny text, and never scales
  down below full size. New *Interface size* setting (Auto, Larger, Largest).
- Card names wrap onto two lines instead of being cut off on narrower screens.
- The budget box no longer covers the timeline at 1024×768; crisis labels on
  the timeline shorten to C1–C4 when space is tight.
- Names on the map no longer print over each other or over the panel text.
- The start screen and other long dialogs keep their buttons in view.

Same rules as 0.13: two-player codes work between 0.13 and 0.13.1.

Full history: see What's new on the playtest page.
